Creates recurring cash tied to Elevai sales without new dilution or debt.
Improves visibility and enforcement versus contingent earnout timing risk.
Cash collected at subsidiary level; structure may aid enforcement and allocation.
No equity issuance or new debt
Non-dilutive cash flows can support M&A strategy and liquidity.
